title: Artifact Return To Reader State
summary: A governed return path from exact evidence requirement through intake, identity, stage testing, independent review, decision receipt, propagation, and release verification.
map_question: How can a returned artifact change reader state without bypassing identity, stage, review, receipt, and propagation controls?
interpretation_boundary: The map describes a required review path. It does not establish that a returned artifact qualifies, and no node publishes directly.

nodes.label: Exact evidence requirement
nodes.note: The packet names the entity, stage, artifact, authority, scope, period, method, denominator, exceptions, and correction trail.

nodes.label: Returned artifact envelope
nodes.note: The envelope records the scheduled or triggered check without changing evidence state.

nodes.label: Entity and authority lock
nodes.note: The returned record must match the named entity, receiving system, authority, and scope.

nodes.label: Stage-specific test
nodes.note: Only validation, acceptance, recurring operation, or comparable outcome named by the packet may be answered.

nodes.label: Independent human review
nodes.note: A structurally complete artifact is eligible for review, not automatic publication.

nodes.label: Bounded decision receipt
nodes.note: Change, watch, correction, no-change, or blocker outcomes preserve the review date and basis.

nodes.label: Complete reader propagation
nodes.note: The signal, same-entity event, gate, matrix, dossiers, pathways, maps, update, and release contract move together.

nodes.label: Silent or partial propagation
nodes.note: A receipt or signal-only change without complete propagation is rejected.

links.note: A return envelope must begin with an exact evidence requirement.
A discovered artifact must pass same-entity and authority checks.
Identity alone does not answer the named stage question.
A complete test result remains subject to independent review.
A reader-visible decision requires an explicit receipt.
The receipt must move every affected surface together.
Partial propagation fails the release contract.

what_this_map_supports: One inspectable path from exact requirement to reader state.
Explicit no-change, watch, correction, and blocker outcomes.
Same-entity event and matrix updates only after a real qualifying receipt.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish that a scheduled artifact exists.
It does not turn structural completeness into evidence sufficiency.
It does not automate publication, rank files, or score readiness.
next_records_needed: Real artifacts returned on or after their scheduled or triggered review date.
